subject: Handle role change error in `cluster setslot` when migrating the last slot away with allow-replica-migration enabled (#466)
reason: The only behavioural change is in valkey-cli's clusterManagerMoveSlot (src/valkey-cli.c): after moving a primary's last slot away with cluster-allow-replica-migration enabled, it now also tolerates a '-UNBLOCKED' role-change error (in addition to the existing 'Please use SETSLOT only with masters.') when informing the source node. Reaching it needs a multi-primary cluster with a replica on the source and a nondeterministic race where the source demotes itself to a replica while the reshard client is blocked on it awaiting SETSLOT pre-replication. The fuzzer cannot drive this: valkey.action.too
